split: leave-one-video-out, both channels together; four folds
initialization: fresh ImageNet ResNet18 each fold, no prior occlusion weights
test_sampling: all frames at 30 fps after visible blood entry
model_selection: fixed final epoch; no test-driven tuning
labels: 0 before workbook OT, 1 at/after OT; assumes persistent occlusion after OT
roi: fixed x=[70,240] left and [480,670] right; full height; no label-based ROI fitting
onset_definition: start of first run of 5 positive frames; confirmation arrives 4 frames later
orientation: top_to_bottom; source orientation from manifest; no vertical augmentation
scope: OT-based experimental labels, not independent frame-by-frame annotations
